items.Sentence: The treatment system consists of a 300,000-gallon oxidation ditch, secondary clarifier, chlorine disinfection using calcium hypochlorite tablets, and dechlorination using sodium bisulfite.

The Facility discharges treated wastewater to three percolation ponds at Discharge Point 002.
The Dogwood lift station pumps raw wastewater into an 8-inch pressure main down Dogwood Lane, under the South Fork Eel River, and cross-country to the Facility...
Grit is periodically removed from the lift station wet well.
Solids removed from the secondary clarifier are dewatered in the Facility’s sludge drying beds or an Aeromod Draimad bagger before being transported to an approved landfill for final disposal.
